data.name: Najwaah
data.gender_notes: Najwaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Najwaah is derived from the Arabic root 'najw', which means 'to be gentle or gracious'. This name is associated with the delicate nature of flowers and is often given to girls with soft, refined personalities. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said: 'The most beloved to me among my nation are the ones with beautiful manners and good character.'
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah grant you a gentle and gracious heart, always striving for good character.
data.etymology: Najwaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Gracious, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najwaah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
